observations: Photo 0 shows 18 M.2 SSDs arranged in two columns on a wooden surface.
All SSDs have white labels with barcodes, QR codes, and regulatory marks (CE, UKCA, etc.).
The labels are mostly identical, with visible text including 'HDD Data CB278', 'PN: E20.SPE.L8550-002', 'Rev: E20.SPE.L8550-002', and '256GB 2021/11/01'.
Some SSDs have a small black sticker with 'GENX3' written on it, but it is not on all units.
The SSDs appear to be of the same model and size (M.2 2280 form factor).
No brand name is clearly visible on any label; the only readable text is 'HDD Data CB278' and 'GENX3' on a sticker.
The seller claims 'Solid state drive 256GB ssd M2 Genx3', but the photo shows multiple units, not one.

claims.claim: Solid state drive 256GB ssd M2 Genx3
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 256GB M.2 SSDs with 'HDD Data CB278' on the label, but 'Genx3' is only visible on a small sticker on some units, not on the main label. The brand is not clearly readable.

risks.risk: The SSDs may be counterfeit or rebranded, as the brand is not clearly visible and 'Genx3' is not a known SSD brand.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the label showing the full brand name and model number, or a photo of the SSD in a system with the model visible in BIOS or disk management.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic or low-end SSD, with lower value due to brand uncertainty

risks.risk: The SSDs may be used or refurbished, not new as implied by the listing.
risks.proof: A photo of the SSDs in their original packaging or a serial number check via manufacturer's website.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/refurbished, with lower value

risks.risk: The SSDs may not be functional or may have degraded performance due to wear.
risks.proof: A video or screenshot showing the SSDs being tested in a system with SMART data or benchmark results.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with unknown functionality

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the label on one SSD showing the full brand name and model number.
Photo of the SSDs in their original packaging, if available.
Video or screenshot of the SSDs being tested in a system with SMART data or benchmark results.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as 256GB M.2 SSDs, but the brand and model are not clearly readable. The seller's claim of 'Genx3' is unverified, and there are significant risks regarding authenticity, condition, and functionality. Proof is needed to determine the true value.
